purpose: Full local foundation-corpus audit; no training or model-size approval
tokenizer: preserved byte-level BPE total vocabulary 16384; exact encoding of original text; no retraining
language: whole document and every 1024-character window with >=40 alphabetic characters must be fastText English probability >=0.8
quality: Reject encoding/control corruption, excessive literal escapes, HTML/code boilerplate, contact/secret signals, repeated lines (>30% when >=8 lines), repeated five-word shingles (>20%), dominant word (>15%). No factual-truth certification.
deduplication: NFKC/casefold/punctuation-normalized exact match, then complete prefix-filtered all-pairs five-word shingle Jaccard >=0.8; no sampling, no truncation
protection: All official and historical heldout documents, retained evaluation requests/responses and full contexts; exact/near/contained-span matches propagate to the full connected family
family: Original source ID, normalized URL/host family, duplicate connected components; Cosmopedia unresolved underlying source identities quarantined
split: After quarantine and dedup: stable family-hash train/dev/test thresholds 90/5/5; no item-level split
